__prompts__.package_name: Your Python package name, in snake case (e.g. my_package)
__prompts__.github_username: Your GitHub username, the owner of the new repo
__prompts__.license: Pick a license, as an SPDX expression for pyproject.toml, see https://choosealicense.com/ for details
__prompts__.author: Author name for pyproject.toml
__prompts__.dev_python_version: Python version for local development, in {major}.{minor} (e.g. 3.12)
__prompts__.aws_region: AWS region every environment (dev, tst, prd) deploys to (e.g. us-east-1)
__prompts__.github_token_field: GitHub token field. Read https://github.com/MacHu-GWU/home_secret_toml-project to learn how to set up your tokens using home_secret.toml
